items.item: RIDOFLEX FULL PUR FULL EPDM SYSTEM
items.description:
Providing and laying IAAF/WA Approved Make in India/Switzerland/USA/Japan,
synthetic athletic track surface (Full PUR Full EPDM System).
Providing and laying Synthetic Athletic Track of FULL PUR FULL EPDM System
having a minimum thickness 15mm with valid product approval certificate and
laboratory test certificates from World Athletics (WA), including markings on the
surface all complete as per requirements/ specifications laid down by World Athletics/
IAAF and Class-II certification.
1. The proposed product should be certified by World Athletic (Earlier IAAF) for a
minimum thickness of 15 mm for Class II Track.
2. The proposed product/brand should be of Indian/American/Swiss/Japanese origin
only.
Providing & Laying of Synthetic Athletic Track: Type Full PUR Full EPDM
Surface Preparation & Inspection: The Sub-base needs to properly prepared and
inspected for any irregularities, cracks or rough spots and treated before starting the
application.
Primer Application: Special polyurethane (PU) primer that is specifically designed to
create a bond between the asphalt and concrete sub-bases and polyurethane coatings
is to be applied evenly throughout the area to be covered with a help of a roller or
sprayer and allow it to cure for minimum 12 hours.
PUR Layer Application: The system is applied in 3 different layers to achieve WA
standards performance; The buildup of the system starts with 2 base layers of 5mm
each made with PU and EPDM (Thickness 10mm) and encapsulated with the final
wear layer of EPDM and PU (5mm Thick) making it a total thickness of 15mm.
